"[[A Closed Fist Has No Claws]]" establishes that the section depicting the [[Unidentified Jedi (Marda Ro)|Jedi's]] [[death]] aboard the ''[[Gaze Electric]]'' takes place when [[Marda Ro]] is roughly eighteen [[Standard year|years]] old. ''[[The High Republic: Path of Deceit]]'', which ''[[Star Wars: The High Republic Character Encyclopedia]]'' dates the events of to [[382 BBY]], establishes both that members of the [[Path of the Open Hand]] receive full membership at the age of fifteen and that Ro had recently become a full member, meaning that she is around fifteen years old. Therefore, the section of "A Closed Fist Has No Claws" depicting the Jedi's death must take place around [[379 BBY]].<noinclude>
